essence: One should show or present the required element
Failure to perform the action makes the priest sinful and the worship ineffective
The guru vessel, enjoyment vessel, and śakti vessel are to be taken up next
One should perform the placement of the vessels according to the method of the common arghya
One should place a pure piece of māṣa-measure in the vessels
